body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: cut**

"Keeps its own flags" restates the signature: the overload takes view<bf16, Aligned, Dma, ...> and returns const_k_row_view<Cols, Aligned, Dma>. The parenthetical is caller context about model.hpp, and the caller already carries it (model.hpp line 3112: "The row view keeps the K buffer's alignment and DMA flags").

Proposed: cut the comment.
